thread:
maria-sec: FYI I found a public paste that contains output from `vault kv get secret/staging/partner-api`. It includes a live API token (I verified small suffix).

sam-oncall: ack. please DM the suffix and Ill kick off revocation. Dont post the full token here.

maria-sec: DM sent (suffix ...xz9). Creating this thread to coordinate rotation + forensics.

sam-oncall: revoking token now with `vault token revoke s.xxxxxx` -> returned 200, token revoked. Report any txn failures.

alex-eng: which services rely on secret/staging/partner-api? tagging owners.

maria-sec: relayer-staging is the primary consumer (owner @alex-eng). Also partner webhook runner uses it.

paul-platform: relayer issues short-lived GCP creds via Vault GCP secrets engine. Ill pull the issuance audit to see which SA was minted.

jenna-sre: audit query: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND protoPayload.methodName=GoogleCloudVaultAccess" --limit 50` (local shorthand). Found an issuance to `relayer-staging@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` at 2026-03-21T10:12:03Z. Also saw reads from IPs 203.0.113.45 (partner) and 198.51.100.12 (unknown).

maria-sec: unknown IP flagged. @alex-eng can you map that IP to a pod/user? Add to watchlist.

alex-eng: correlating egress logs -> 10:12 UTC: pod `relayer-5b7f` (sha=abc123) made an outbound connection to 198.51.100.12. That matches a short HTTP POST. Suspect the pod leaked creds or the partner pulled them.

sam-oncall: immediate triage checklist: revoke exposed token (done), rotate KV secret, rotate any derived cloud creds, rewrap KMS if wrapping key could be exposed, tighten Vault policies & TTLs, preserve audit logs.

paul-platform: proposed steps for re-encryption: create a new KMS cryptoKeyVersion and run a rewrap job that pulls existing ciphertext blobs from GCS and rewrites using new key version. I'll queue a batch job.

maria-sec: partner claims it was a debug paste; they say they deleted it. We asked for proof of deletion + if they stored a copy. Waiting on attestation.

jenna-sre: I've exported Vault audit records and pushed to a locked bucket `gs://sec-forensics/3301112223/`. Snapshot preserved with retention and restricted ACLs.

alex-eng: rotating secret now: `vault kv put secret/staging/partner-api api_key=rotated-2026-03-21-1` then updating k8s secret via sealed secret update. Will restart pods after swap.

paul-platform: immediate mitigation for SA keys: create a new ephemeral SA via Workload Identity mapping and swap, avoid long-lived SA keys. Short term: create new key and rotate.

sam-oncall: i pushed a temporary firewall denylist for 198.51.100.12 and added an egress rule to block non-whitelisted destinations from staging namespace.

maria-sec: RBAC changes I propose: tighten the `relayer-staging` Vault policy to only allow `read` on `secret/staging/partner-api` (no wildcards), enforce `max_ttl = 30m` and `token_type = batch` for the relayer role. I'll open a PR with diffs.

jenna-sre: set up alerting: created a metric for `vault.kv.get` on path `secret/staging/partner-api` and an alert if reads > 2/min. Added to PD escalation.

paul-platform: ETA for rewrap: 24h for one-off re-encrypt job. Workload Identity migration ETA: 72h.

maria-sec: forensics asks: 1) partner deletion proof, 2) full list of read events + client IPs, 3) list of tokens/keys minted from that secret, 4) evidence of exfil copy.

sam-oncall: marking incident INC-2026-0423 with severity=medium, owners=eng-security,platform.

redwood-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created and assigned to @eng-security.

alex-eng: rolled relayer after secret swap: `kubectl -n staging set env deploy/relayer PARTNER_API_KEY=rotated-2026-03-21-1 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/relayer` -> rollout OK. No immediate alerts.

maria-sec: keep partner attestation pending. If they cannot prove deletion or claim copies exist, expand rotation to partner production resources.

paul-platform: Ill run a rewrap smoke test after KMS key version creation and post logs to this thread.

jenna-sre: preserved logs and added a DLP scan on the paste URL (archived) to see if other secrets leaked. No other matches so far.

sam-oncall: any impact to production? Confirmed none. This is contained to staging.

maria-sec: draft incident notes will go to INC-2026-0423 runbook: detection -> containment -> eradication -> recovery -> actions. Will include RBAC PR link, rewrap job link, and forensic exports. Expect initial notes within 1 hour.

paul-platform: assigning rewrap job to infra-runner and scheduling a follow-up to migrate relayer to Workload Identity.

maria-sec: thanks everyone. If partner provides evidence of exfil, well escalate severity. For now reconvene if new suspicious reads show up. :thumbsup:
